answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, but correlated equivocation across k coordinated identities triggers penalties proportional to O(k²), reflecting pairwise evidence of collusion. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation rapidly reducing recovered stake and future influence. This trellis makes sybil control costly: an oasis of honest nodes remains viable, while umber-marked colluders cannot cheaply reconstitute.
